scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 LimitRange and ResourceQuota admission, an owned Job's declared memory and Job-controller deadline, and a separate nonroot Job exercising synthetic queue and input bounds. Production queue integration, dataset size, aggregate memory and availability requirements require separate deployed evidence.

checks.claim: Without a memory bound, the oversized synthetic Pod reaches admission
Without storage bounds, the oversized synthetic PVC reaches admission
Pod admission defaults omitted memory to the fixed namespace ceiling
Pod admission rejects an explicit memory limit above the ceiling

observed.detail: Error from server (Forbidden): error when creating "STDIN": pods "saf-0703-005-memory-over" is forbidden: maximum memory usage per Container is 64Mi, but limit is 65Mi

checks.claim: PVC admission rejects a claim above the per-claim storage bound

observed.detail: Error from server (Forbidden): error when creating "STDIN": persistentvolumeclaims "saf-0703-005-pvc-over" is forbidden: maximum storage usage per PersistentVolumeClaim is 8Mi, but request is 9Mi

checks.claim: PVC admission permits aggregate requested storage at the namespace quota
PVC admission rejects aggregate requested storage above the namespace quota

checks.claim: Admission permits the declared memory ceiling
The Job rejects full-queue and oversized input and preserves FIFO recovery
